description: This file is an ASP.NET WebForms code-behind class that handles displaying and submitting answers and marks for a specific course. It interacts with a database to retrieve student answers for different questions, display them, and allow submission of marks, as well as navigation controls.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ShowAns ASP.NET page, handling display and submission of answers and marks for course questions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves answers from database for each question based on session data and displays them.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks from input, updates the database with the submitted marks, removes the student from course queue, and navigates to the course queue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.
